page.overview:
Who is Airport Security Official?

The airport security official is an unnamed man who previously worked for security at LaGuardia Airport located in Queens, New York City. He makes his first and only appearance in "Lisa Goes Gaga."

When Lady Gaga is traveling by plane and takes metal objects out, before passing through the metal detector. So many of her metal objects, however, airport security informs Lady Gaga that she missed her flight, much to her to have party on the board ramp. Subsequently, after the moment begin dancing, he ran after her to join party as well and quitting his job.
